1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pergigian (Pengurangan Tempoh

Khidmat Awam) 2013.

Pengurangan tempoh khidmat awam

2. Menteri membenarkan orang yang dinamakan dalam Jadual pengurangan

tempoh khidmat awam daripada tiga (3) tahun kepada dua (2) tahun sebagaimana yang

diperuntukkan di bawah seksyen 48 Akta.

DENTAL ACT 1971

DENTAL (REDUCTION OF PUBLIC SERVICE PERIOD) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 49(1)(a) of the Dental Act 1971

[Act 51], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Dental (Reduction of Public Service Period)

Order 2013.

Reduction of public service period

2. The Minister grants the persons named in the Schedule a reduction of public

service period from three (3) years to two (2) years as provided under section 48 of the

Act.
